provenance: DOI and license of each dataset, captured by hand on checkedOn from the DataCite record of the DOI (https://api.datacite.org/dois/<doi>). PSI's own investigation service (https://psi.nasa.gov/geode-py/ws/repo/investigations/<accession>) answered HTTP 500 on that day, so the PSI page could not be read.
